data.title: Tidy up shopping data key names

description.text: I renamed the keys in the shopping data so they all match.
Already released to production (the app real users use) at 14:05.

checks.text: Automatic tests: 3 of 3 passed (tests use the new sample data)

explanation: Errors jumped from 0.2% to 18% right after the 14:05 release, because production data still uses the key "cost", not "price". Roll back to the healthy version first so the cashier app works again, then fix it calmly.
hints: Compare the error numbers before and after the release time.
